revisions.note: Rows marked revision "skeptic-round" were re-measured after the skeptic fixes (compat.js, boot-frame guard, worker integrity checks, IPA font and per-item packs in the precache) on the built tree (release 709b1a90e06c), mobile, 3 runs each, scenarios a, b, f, g, u and d/c for the routes listed in after.md; every other row is the headline run. Same-window comparison against the previous head (16c6dbf, release 6e01c455e024) is in after.md.

Rows marked revision "verify2" were re-measured after the second skeptic round's fixes (the worker serves only bodies with its own headers and hashes every response as it is served, leaves release.json to the network, installs nothing without release.json, never hands the page a module of another release; 128-bit per-file hashes) on the built tree (release 61cdec2e3120), mobile, 3 runs each: scenarios a, b, c (reading, checkpoint/A1), d (six routes), e, f, g and u. Same-window comparisons against the previous head (fe6b9af, release 709b1a90e06c) and the base (b2b669b) are in after.md, "Second skeptic round".

Rows marked revision "verify3" were re-measured after the third skeptic round's fixes (a load of the app hands over to a waiting release; a full origin never fails an install; saved lessons carried over at activation when storage is full) on the built tree (release 6a35f1a0edfa), mobile, 3 runs each: scenarios f, g and u, the rows those fixes could move. Same-window comparisons against the previous head (40b402b, release 61cdec2e3120) and the base (b2b669b) are in after.md, "Third skeptic round".
